paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥmani (or bar Naḥman), chapter Ellu Terefot (49a), Shabbat (37a). Bar Naḥmani said: R. Oshaya said. He said, 'R. Elazar said,' Niddah (48a). R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥman learned from R. Elazar, etc.; 'But R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥman said to R. Avudma of Ḥaifa,' Jerusalem Talmud, Niddah, end of chapter 2. In the name of R. Ḥanina ben Gamliel, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Ein Omedin, mishnah 2. R. Yehudah Nesia (see above). R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥman said: R. Yehoshua ben Levi was in Laodicea, and R. Yehudah Nesia was there; R. Zeira asked R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥman. A case came before R. Yose, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter HeArel, halakhah 1. R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥmani said, 'I saw R. Yehoshua ben Levi go out in a cork sandal on Yom Kippur,' Yoma, chapter 8 (78, beginning of side b). He asked R. Yehoshua ben Levi, Ḥullin (45a). 'It was explained to me personally by R. Yehoshua ben Levi,' end of chapter Ein Omedin (34b). R. Yose (see above). R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥman: R. Yaakov bar Aḥa, in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot, chapter 11. He and R. Yaakov bar Idi gave a dinar to Rav Ḥama bar Bisna (see his entry). R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥmani said: Shemuel said, Rosh HaShanah (13b), Sukkah (30a); in Tosafot there (29b), citing the Jerusalem Talmud: bar Naḥman. In Tosafot, Menaḥot (30, end of side b), chapter Gid HaNasheh (90b). Bar Naḥman, in Shemuel's name, Jerusalem Talmud, end of chapter Shenayim Oḥazin. Bar Naḥmani said: Resh Lakish said, Bekhorot (13a). With R. Shimon ben Pazi, and he disagrees with him, Megillah (23a), Shevuot (16b), Sanhedrin (10b).
